reviews.title: It Takes A Village
reviews.contents: I’m a travel RN and I travel with my family. Being a new mother was nerve racking because I was going to be no where near my family for help. I see a pediatrician to ensure developmental milestones are being met and ensuring my child’s optimal health, however; having advice with science based evidence on sleeping, play, language, and nutrition has been the most helpful. It is not just one expert, but many who console your doubts. They don’t only focus on development from one part of the world but ensuring development for all and I think that avoids limiting possibilities and options for little ones. I love the masterclasses, as well as, the live classes. It is wonderful to have experts opinions on your particular case and Kinedu makes it easy to communicate with them. If you’re a new parent and have doubts in any aspect of your child development this app is the one to help. Kinedu also gives an option to track your babies milestones, sleep, feed, and restroom use. No one can raise a child alone, it takes a village to ensure their happiness and growth.

reviews.title: **3 MAJOR THINGS TO KNOW BEFORE DOWNLOADING** READ
reviews.contents:
1. I downloaded the app and before even getting into it my phone started acting up and being insanely slow. I get into the app and start making my account and it says I need a subscription to continue but I can get a 7 day free trial. Cool. So I do the free trial. The whole time I’m in the app it is INSANELY slow to the point where I can’t even turn my phone off, get out of the app, or anything. Eventually I do and I refresh but it’s still being super slow. I even restarted my phone and uninstalled and reinstalled the app and the app is still barely working for me (by working I mean I can open the app and maybe scroll down after a whole minute of waiting for it to actually scroll) I know it’s not my phone because once it was uninstalled Emmy phone was working fine then when I downloaded it again the problems started back up.
2. When the app was barely working everything I clicked on said I needed to upgrade to premium but like…I accepted the free trial. And I KNOW I got it because in my subscription tab on the App Store it literally says I have it. So what is the point of the “free trial” if it doesn’t allow me to do NOT A SINGLE THING on the app?
3. I wish I read the bad reviews before downloading because based off of those a lot of people still get charge the $80 for the subscription even after they cancel the free trial. I already uninstalled the app and cancelled my trial but I will make an update if I get charged even tho I couldn’t even attempt to use this app and it didn’t allow me to use the trial AND I already cancelled it. Major MAJOR issues. I was exited about this app too. SMH

reviews.title: Great developmental activities
reviews.contents:
I downloaded this app and paid for the upgrade when my son was around 2 months old. I was looking for activities to make sure that he was learning and growing at a good pace. This app has so much that you can do with things around your house, no need to spend money on expensive games toys etc. 

My only bit of advice is to be careful because the app will provide you with activities based on what your child has already achieved. So if your kid is an overachiever it might suggest an activity that’s a bit advanced for your child. They do advise you of that, but you need to keep that in mind. For a few days it listed the suggested age for the activity, but I don’t see that now. It would be great if that was brought back. It’s very helpful if I’m unsure if my son is ready for the activity.

Functionality of the app is good too, doesn’t freeze or shut down. Overall love the app!

reviews.title: Confusing app, constant upsell, spammy emails
reviews.contents: This app is terrible! I entered my baby’s age and tried to explore the daily developmental activities, but the UI was too confusing to get very far. There were about 20 different things to click on in the layout, and the first half had nothing to do with the activities I should do with my baby. They were trying to get me to take classes, participate in Q&A, and tell me the importance of breastfeeding. When I finally found the developmental activities, they were so simple I had to laugh. Have your baby look at their surroundings, really? I was looking for creative activities I wouldn’t think of on my own as a first time mom. Every time I clicked on something or tried to return to the main menu, the app would try to upsell me to pay for a subscription. I also got THREE emails from Kinedu within two hours of downloading the app, which was overboard and intrusive. Lastly, I tried to look up others’ experiences with Kinedu on Reddit and noticed the co-founder kept commenting on every thread telling people why this app is so wonderful. Why don’t you let actual users discuss their experience? I deleted this app already and will keep looking.

reviews.title: Loved this app
reviews.contents: I loved this app - I thought it was amazing that with you subscription you get access to real live experts for sleep training and group therapy (and other things; those are just the ones I was interested in). There’s an always on group me chat for those things and there are also live zoom trainings you can attend and ask questions about your situation multiple times a week. I have hit the milestones I wanted to with sleep and found myself not needing the app as much, so I cancelled my subscription. I was also impressed that cancelling was so easy - they aren’t trying to hide it and make it impossible for you to cancel. I appreciated that so much that I came to write a review. I really liked this app and the experts I got to work with through it. I was genuinely impressed. It was a God send when I needed it and I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Great suggestions and milestones
reviews.contents: I have been using Kinedu for a couple months now and find it a great resource in aiding me in creating a more rich educational experience for my daughter. It’s a great well designed app with daily suggestions for stimulating activities, and articles about development. It helps if your ever having trouble of thinking of new activities to engage your babies development. It has great milestones with common age points to help you see what is common behaviors for your child’s age group. This is one of the top apps I would suggest any new parent to have, it only helps. Many days I don’t remember to use it but it’s handy having a quick resource and idea base for helping my child develop healthier. Also if you do forget to check everyday you can go back and check the activities from the day before, it also will update according to your child’s unique progress.

reviews.title: Adore it.
reviews.contents: This offers everything. Seriously. You can do as little or as much as you want on this app. The live classes are unexpectedly personal and VERY helpful. I feel like I needed this very much for my mental state. It helped me feel like I was more on top of my little one’s growth and health. I would love to see them help the nap adjustment though…if I started a sleep I can only edit when it started but not ended unless I do the math and just reenter it manually. It’s not horrible but there should be that option as I don’t always remember to stop the nap in the moment. Also when pausing the nap or bedtime sleep,  it adds on the time it was paused for instead of subtracting it from her sleep (which it is). I’m sure they’ll fix this as it’s kind of annoying. But I adore so much of this app!!

reviews.title: CONPLETE Waste of Money. Costumer Service is Nonexistent
reviews.contents:
I’m a first time mom and was checking out different apps to find something that could help me teach my son what he needs to know. I tried the free trial, only to be billed a day earlier than the trial ended (I had already decided that I wasn’t going to buy the subscription with Kinedu and planned to cancel the night before the trial ended). However I was billed $60+ for the entire year prematurely. I emailed Kinedu telling them what happened and that I wanted a refund and cancellation of my subscription. They didn’t respond  to my email. I cancelled my subscription from my end, hoping to get the refund soon. It has now been almost a month and I have now reached out to the customer support team MULTIPLE times to get a refund or to AT LEAST reinstate my subscription so that I can actually use the YEARLY subscription that I was charged for!!  No response. I would have called Kinedu immediately, however apparently the only form of contact is through email. 
** DO NOT BUY. **
Worst service I have ever received. Biggest regret and such a waste of a lot of money.

reviews.title: Not so helpful beyond the baby stage; quality of some live content has declined… and why WhatsApp
reviews.contents:
I loved Kinedu the first year I had it, when my son was a baby. But during the toddler stage, it hasn’t been as valuable. Very little content and live little classes are targeted to parents of children older than the newborn and baby stages. The in-app activities are helpful, but the automatic recommendations are frequently off and I keep having to adjust them, despite keeping my child’s developmental milestones updated. Moreover, the quality and consistency of the live classes has declined over the past year. Live play sessions are fewer and fewer, and I miss Andrea’s sessions and her wisdom. I also miss psychologist Alice Ravize. Other psychologists have come and gone, and it’s not the same since she left. 

Other problems I have:
- community features being removed in favor of AI. I miss having direct access to other members of the Kinedu community through the app, especially as I’m back at work and can’t join as many of the live classes as I used to. I wish Kinedu kept some form of asynchronous community interaction.
- update: they now have WhatsApp groups for announcements and engagement, and I don’t get it. Why is this necessary? Why can’t this happen within the Kinedu app?

I probably won’t be renewing Kinedu Premium next year, since my son will already be three and a half.

reviews.title: Incredible App
reviews.contents: I am a first time mom to twins. To say I’m a little out of my comfort zone is a understatement. I had no idea where to start and what to do to entertain two little growing minds. Kinedu has been such a life saver! The daily activities to try are so refreshing and new, the twins usually love them! I have also learned so much from attending the live classes offered daily M-F. You are able to join for free and learn from trained professionals on a WIDE range of topics. The tracking features for your baby are so simple to use and allow for a peice of mind when it comes to feedings, their sleep/wake windows, diaper changes, growth, and pump sessions (if this applies to you). I have never been so blown away by an app for parents regarding the development of their child. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!
